methodology.timingIncludes: Input application, periodic public-state reset, actual RigidBody.integrate and checksum accumulation.
methodology.timingExcludes: Imports, input generation, exact comparisons, identity checks and hashes.
methodology.allocationLimit: Owned vector/quaternion counts and stable identities are measured; this is not a complete transient heap-allocation profiler.
methodology.scopeLimit: Synthetic force/torque/rotor trajectories on unchanged catalogue mass/inertia; not a full vehicle/world simulation or FPS prediction.
